sentences.c: Without the external cue, the difference accumulates and so the internally regulated activities of the biological day drift continuously, like the tides, in relation to the solar day.
sentences.cn_source: 如果没有外界提示信号，这种差异就会积累，生物的日常内部调节活动就继续进行，像与太阳日有关的潮汐活动那样。

trans.cn: bắt kịp; Vui lên; tuân thủ; tiếp tục, duy trì
trans.cn_source: 赶上；振作；遵守；继续，保持

sentences.c: You need to cut down on starches.
sentences.cn_source: 你有必要少吃些含淀粉的东西。

sentences.c: The doctor told him to cut down on his drinking.
sentences.cn_source: 医生劝他少喝酒。

sentences.c: We're trying to cut down on the amount of paperwork involved.
sentences.cn_source: 我们正在努力降低有关此事的文书工作量。

trans.cn: cắt đứt, cắt đứt; cắt đứt, cô lập
trans.cn_source: 切去，割掉；切断，使孤立

sentences.c: The wicked stepmother told one of her two daughters to cut off her big toe to fit into the shoe.
sentences.cn_source: 那个邪恶的继母叫她的两个女儿中的一个把她的大脚趾剪下来，以适应鞋子的大小。

sentences.c: Despite objections by the White House, the Senate voted today to cut off aid.
sentences.cn_source: 尽管白宫反对，参议院今天投票中断援助。

sentences.c: One of the goals of the campaign is to cut off the elite Republican Guard from its supplies.
sentences.cn_source: 那场战役的目标之一就是切断精锐的共和国卫队的供给。

trans.cn: cho đến nay
trans.cn_source: 迄今为止

trans.cn: - cho đến nay, cho đến nay
trans.cn_source: - 迄今，到现在为止

sentences.c: Make sure your vaccinations are up to date.
sentences.cn_source: 一定要接种最新的疫苗。

sentences.c: To date, we have received over 200 replies.
sentences.cn_source: 到目前为止，我们已收到200多封回信。

sentences.c: Our computers are bang up to date.
sentences.cn_source: 我们的电脑是最先进的。

trans.cn: Liên hệ với; từ khi tồn tại cho đến ngày nay
trans.cn_source: 与…接触；自…时代存在至今

sentences.c: My family has a vase, which is said to date back to Ming Dynasty.
sentences.cn_source: 我家有个花瓶，据说是从明代传下来的。

sentences.c: The stone circle is said to date back to 3200 BC and is a vision in itself.
sentences.cn_source: 它可以追溯到公元前3200年，是一处很独特的景点。

sentences.c: In Sanliurfa Province, outbreaks in backyard poultry are now thought to date back to late November 2005.
sentences.cn_source: 现认为在桑尼乌法省，后院家禽中的暴发始于2005年11月下旬。

trans.cn: Quy trình
trans.cn_source: 处理

trans.cn: Deal with: Talking to or meeting someone, especially as part of work.
trans.cn_source: 处理：与某人交谈或会见某人，尤其是作为工作的一部分。

sentences.c: He has some unfinished business to deal with.
sentences.cn_source: 他还要处理一些尚未了结的事务。

sentences.c: We must take positive steps to deal with the problem.
sentences.cn_source: 我们必须采取积极步骤处理这个问题。

sentences.c: I prefer to deal with him direct.
sentences.cn_source: 我更愿意直接跟他打交道。

trans.cn: Tranh luận về
trans.cn_source: 关于…进行辩论

sentences.c: The class decided to debate on the housing question.
sentences.cn_source: 班级决定讨论房子问题。

sentences.c: The debate about megafauna pivots to a great degree on the techniques for dating old bones and the sediments in which they are buried.
sentences.cn_source: 关于巨型动物的争论在很大程度上取决于确定古老骨骼和埋藏它们的沉积物年代的技术。

sentences.c: He is expected to force a debate in Congress on his immigration reform.
sentences.cn_source: 他预期会推动一个关于他的移民改革的正式讨论。

trans.cn: quyết định, lựa chọn
trans.cn_source: 决定，选定

sentences.c: We're still trying to decide on a venue.
sentences.cn_source: 我们仍然在设法选定一个会场。

sentences.c: Denikin held a staff meeting to decide on the next strategic objective.
sentences.cn_source: 德尼金召开了员工大会为下一步的战略目标作出决定。

sentences.c: If the bride pays, she has the right to decide on the style of dress worn by her attendants.
sentences.cn_source: 如果新娘付费，她有权决定她的婚礼随员穿什么款式。

trans.cn: Dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào; phụ thuộc vào
trans.cn_source: 依赖，依靠；依…而定

trans.cn: Phụ thuộc vào ai đó hoặc điều gì đó: đề cập đến việc phụ thuộc vào ai đó hoặc điều gì đó và cần sự hỗ trợ hoặc giúp đỡ của họ.
trans.cn_source: 依赖某人或某物：指对某人或某物有所依赖，需要其支持或帮助。

sentences.c: You know, you are supposed to depend on yourself.
sentences.cn_source: 你知道的，你应该依靠自己。

sentences.c: Many farmers have to depend on subsidies to make a living wage.
sentences.cn_source: 许多农民不得不依靠补助来维持基本的生活需要。

sentences.c: I don't like to depend on my parents too much.
sentences.cn_source: 我不喜欢过多依赖我的父母。

trans.cn: bắt nguồn từ, bắt nguồn từ...
trans.cn_source: 从…得到，源出于…

sentences.c: The complex style of the medieval wooden church carvings and the skills used to make them almost certainly to derive from the ancient Viking tradition.
sentences.cn_source: 几乎可以肯定，中世纪木制教堂雕刻的复杂风格和制作它们的技巧来自古代维京人的传统。

sentences.c: Modern musical scales are also said to derive from the Arabic alphabet.
sentences.cn_source: 音阶据说也源自阿拉伯字母表。

sentences.c: A key point to derive from this is that RPC style web services are simply a subset of document-style services in general.
sentences.cn_source: 从这里得出的要点是，rpc样式的Web服务一般只是文档样式的服务的一部分。

trans.cn: Bất đồng về...
trans.cn_source: 对…意见不一

sentences.c: A big agenda can give everyone something they want, but it can also give everyone something to disagree about.
sentences.cn_source: 一个庞大的计划固然能让每个人都从中得益，但也总能让人找出反对的理由。

sentences.c: Morgan and Goldman appear to disagree about the answer.
sentences.cn_source: 摩根·斯坦利和高盛显然对此持否定态度。

sentences.c: It is stuck because the euro zone's dominant powers, France and Germany, agree on the need for greater harmonization within the euro zone, but disagree about what to harmonize.
sentences.cn_source: 它之所以陷入僵局，是因为欧元区的主导力量——法国和德国，都认为有必要在欧元区内部加强协调，但他们在协调哪些方面存在分歧。

trans.cn: Không đồng ý với, không nhất quán với
trans.cn_source: 与…有分歧，不一致

sentences.c: I didn't feel able to disagree with him.
sentences.cn_source: 我觉得无法不同意他的意见。

sentences.c: He suspected that deep down, she admired him for having the gumption to disagree with her.
sentences.cn_source: 他认为，她内心深处其实钦佩他有魄力反对自己的意见。

sentences.c: Here's how to disagree with someone more powerful than you.
sentences.cn_source: 以下是如何向比你更有权力的人提出异议的方法。

trans.cn: Không đồng ý
trans.cn_source: 不同意

sentences.c: If parents are by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
sentences.cn_source: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到不满，不喜欢她的新丈夫，不认同她抚养子女的方式，那么他们很可能不会喜欢她的来访。

sentences.c: If parents are angered by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
sentences.cn_source: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到不满，不喜欢她的新丈夫，不认同她抚养子女的方式，那么他们很可能也不喜欢她回门拜访。

sentences.c: Protestant countries disapprove of cruelty to animals.
sentences.cn_source: 新教徒国家中反对虐待动物。

trans.cn: Không chấp thuận
trans.cn_source: 不赞成

trans.cn: Disapproval: Thể hiện sự không đồng tình hoặc không hài lòng với ai đó hoặc điều gì đó.
trans.cn_source: 不赞成：表示对某人或某事表示反对或不满意的意思。

sentences.c: If you want to pick things to disapprove of, the rating agencies would be far down on the list.
sentences.cn_source: 如果你想要证明机构的误处，信用机构将不会在你考虑范围之内。

sentences.c: Paul is a meticulous taskmaster on a job site, and he tends to disapprove of my cutting corners - as I tried to do by reducing the concrete in the foundation.
sentences.cn_source: 在工地上，保罗是个谨慎的工头，他总是不同意我减少边角，因为我想要减少地基的混凝土。

sentences.c: If parents are by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
sentences.cn_source: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到不满，不喜欢她的新丈夫，不认同她抚养子女的方式，那么他们很可能不会喜欢她的来访。

trans.cn: phân biệt, phân biệt
trans.cn_source: 分辨，区分

sentences.c: Phillip says it's important to distinguish between "person praise" and "process praise".
sentences.cn_source: 菲利普说，区分“对人的表扬”和“对过程的表扬”很重要。

sentences.c: It takes more than a brief encounter on a bus to distinguish between courteous convention and individual interest.
sentences.cn_source: 要区分礼貌习俗和个人兴趣，仅仅在公共汽车上的一次短暂邂逅是不够的。

sentences.c: One useful way is to distinguish between three degrees of poverty—extreme poverty, moderate poverty, and relative poverty.
sentences.cn_source: 一个有效的方法是区分三种程度的贫困——极端贫困、中等贫困和相对贫困。

trans.cn: Tiến hành nghiên cứu về
trans.cn_source: 进行…的研究

sentences.c: It is significant to do research into the legal consciousness of citizens.
sentences.cn_source: 研究市民法律意识是有意义的。

sentences.c: He did not want to bake, so chose to do research into milky white opal glass.
sentences.cn_source: 他不愿意烘焙，所以选择研究乳白色的玻璃。

sentences.c: In view of that, I decide to do research into concrete practice in chemistry to search for the cause of chemistry learning disability and the strategies to solve it.
sentences.cn_source: 鉴于此，主试决定在我们化学学科当中、具体实践方面进行研究、探索中学生化学学习障碍的形成及相应解决策略。

trans.cn: dùng làm nguồn, để nương tựa; được ở gần
trans.cn_source: 用做来源，依靠；临近

sentences.c: To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to draw on our experience from the past.
sentences.cn_source: 为了人类的未来，我们必须借鉴过去的经验。

sentences.c: I'll have to draw on my savings.
sentences.cn_source: 我只得动用我的存款了。

sentences.c: Remember, whenever you want to draw on a sidewalk, always ask an adult in charge for permission before you draw.
sentences.cn_source: 记住，每当你想在人行道上画画时，在绘画之前一定要征得负责人的许可。

trans.cn: giấc mơ; giấc mơ
trans.cn_source: 梦见；梦想

sentences.c: Through reading, they are able to dream of a better life after war.
sentences.cn_source: 通过阅读，他们能够梦想战后更好的生活。

sentences.c: We begin to dream of new possible selves.
sentences.cn_source: 我们开始梦想新的可能的自我。

sentences.c: We were encouraged to dream of having our names in lights.
sentences.cn_source: 我们经常梦想着去拥有属于自己的一切。

trans.cn: kết thúc bằng
trans.cn_source: 以…告终

sentences.c: They went in spring and planned to end in August.
sentences.cn_source: 他们春天出发，计划八月结束。

sentences.c: The programme was set to follow the U.S. space agency's shuttle missions, which are due to end in September.
sentences.cn_source: 该项目原本设定在美国宇航局的航天飞机任务后，后者将于9月结束。

sentences.c: The boom does not have to end in deflation.
sentences.cn_source: 繁荣并非一定以通货紧缩为终点。

trans.cn: kết thúc bằng ; kết thúc bằng
trans.cn_source: 以…结束；以…告终

sentences.c: You don't want to end up with scrambled eggs!
sentences.cn_source: 你可不想要一个不成形的蛋饼吧！

sentences.c: You don't want regulated "utility" Banks to end up with all the worst people.
sentences.cn_source: 人们并不想以无能的人员来规范“高效”银行。

sentences.c: We do not have an [international] treaty but we still need to end up with clear global rules.
sentences.cn_source: 我们没有一项(国际)条约，但我们仍需最终制定出明确的全球规则。

trans.cn: tham gia, bận rộn với
trans.cn_source: 从事，忙于

trans.cn: Tham gia vào một cái gì đó: Tham gia vào một hoạt động hoặc hành vi.
trans.cn_source: 参与某事：参与某项活动或行为。

sentences.c: Even in prison, he continued to engage in criminal activities.
sentences.cn_source: 他甚至在监狱里还继续从事犯罪活动。

sentences.c: It would be pointless to engage in hypothesis before we have the facts.
sentences.cn_source: 在我们还没掌握事实的情况下瞎猜是毫无意义的。

sentences.c: They can get chances to engage in research.
sentences.cn_source: 他们可以有机会从事研究。

trans.cn: vượt xa
trans.cn_source: 超出

trans.cn: quá mức; quá mức
trans.cn_source: 过度；过分

sentences.c: I was reasonably fit, played a lot of tennis, and didn't smoke or drink to excess.
sentences.cn_source: 我那时很健康，常打网球，不过度抽烟或喝酒。

sentences.c: He started drinking to excess after losing his job.
sentences.cn_source: 他失业后便开始酗酒了。

sentences.c: But in one area, greenery might be taken to excess.
sentences.cn_source: 但有一个领域的绿色环保行为可能太过超前。

trans.cn: tiếp xúc; phải đối mặt; bị lộ
trans.cn_source: 暴露；面临；曝露

sentences.c: Next, add the seam: component tag inside of the definition of any Spring bean you would like to expose to JSF.
sentences.cn_source: 接下来，在任何您想要公开给JSF的Spring bean的定义内添加seam： component标记。

sentences.c: Others have existing functionality in legacy systems that they want to expose to clients, partners, and a service ecosystem.
sentences.cn_source: 而其他一些客户在遗留系统中拥有现有的功能，他们希望将其公开给客户、合作伙伴以及服务生态系统。

sentences.c: Decide on which WebSphere Application Server customization to expose to enable the image to be customized and reused in different environments.
sentences.cn_source: 决定公开哪个WebSphere Application Server自定义，以便能够在不同的环境中自定义和重新使用映像。

trans.cn: bỏ cuộc nửa chừng, bỏ cuộc nửa chừng
trans.cn_source: 半途而废，中途退出

sentences.c: Maybe the pajama trend is born of allowing some aspects of our lives to fall by the wayside in favor of other more important things than our appearance.
sentences.cn_source: 也许睡衣潮流的出现，是因为我们生活中的某些方面被其他比外表更重要的东西取代了。

sentences.c: Some things may have to fall by the wayside, but you want to get the most bang for your time buck.
sentences.cn_source: 有些事被迫放弃了，但你希望的是自己花的时间收获最大化。

sentences.c: Albert Gore Jr. apparently ready to fall by the wayside - he can focus on Jesse Jackson one-on-one.
sentences.cn_source: 在那儿-戈尔参议员已经差不多被淘汰了-他可以集中精力一对一与杰克逊周旋。

trans.cn: ác cảm với
trans.cn_source: 对…怀恨

trans.cn: Muốn (làm gì đó), sẵn lòng
trans.cn_source: 想（做某事），愿意

sentences.c: It's perfectly normal to feel like this.
sentences.cn_source: 有这样的感觉是完全正常的。

sentences.c: He looked sufficiently like a king, but he was ill able to feel like one.
sentences.cn_source: 他外表看上去完全像个国王，但他不觉得自己像个国王。

sentences.c: It's going to feel like a made-up conversation that people don't necessarily want to tune in to.
sentences.cn_source: 这将会给别人一种刻意营造的对话的感觉，人们不一定愿意加入到对话中。

trans.cn: chơi đùa, chơi đùa; chơi đùa với
trans.cn_source: 摆弄，玩弄；弄虚作假

sentences.c: Where you get to fiddle with the script.
sentences.cn_source: 你可以在那儿摆弄脚本。

sentences.c: It probably is best not to fiddle with switches or controls when riding in the back seat of an air force plane.
sentences.cn_source: 坐在空军飞机的后座椅时最好不要随便拨弄任何开关或操纵装置。

sentences.c: But if the Fed wants to surprise the markets again, a more radical idea would be to fiddle with its own mandate.
sentences.cn_source: 但是如果美联储想要再度震惊市场，一个更激进的政策无异于是要去玩弄它的托管方。

trans.cn: tập trung
trans.cn_source: 集中

sentences.c: This method gives you a goal to focus on.
sentences.cn_source: 这个方法给了一个可以让你专注的目标。

sentences.c: We turn from the disk subsystem to focus on the processors.
sentences.cn_source: 我们要将焦点从磁盘子系统转移到处理器上。

sentences.c: He prefers to focus on the positive.
sentences.cn_source: 他更愿意关注积极面。

trans.cn: nhìn chằm chằm, quan sát
trans.cn_source: 凝视，注视

sentences.c: If only to gaze at the life consciousness, what to do?
sentences.cn_source: 如果只为了凝视人生，要意识做什么呢？

sentences.c: Grab some guests and head outside to gaze at the Moon together, even if just for a few minutes.
sentences.cn_source: 找些客人和外面其他什么人一起好好看看月亮吧，哪怕只是几分钟呢。

sentences.c: I was going to. But she was beautiful and had suddenly begun to gaze at me with an unmistakable look of respect.
sentences.cn_source: 我正想这么说，发现漂亮的接待员正注视着我，毫无疑问用的是一种尊敬的眼神。

trans.cn: thoát khỏi, thoát khỏi, thoát khỏi
trans.cn_source: 摆脱，解脱，除去

trans.cn: Loại bỏ, loại bỏ: loại bỏ hoặc loại bỏ một cái gì đó hoặc một ai đó.
trans.cn_source: 摆脱，除去：消除或清除某物或某人。

trans.cn: Giải quyết, giải quyết: giải quyết hoặc giải quyết một vấn đề hoặc tình huống khó xử.
trans.cn_source: 解决，处理：处理或解决某个问题或困境。

sentences.c: I began to suspect (that) they were trying to get rid of me.
sentences.cn_source: 我开始觉察出，他们试图摆脱掉我。

sentences.c: I began to have a sinking feeling that I was not going to get rid of her.
sentences.cn_source: 我开始有一种摆脱不掉她的沮丧情绪。

sentences.c: We need to get rid of the idea that we must be liked all the time in order to be worthwhile.
sentences.cn_source: 我们需要摆脱那种必须一直受人爱戴才有价值的观念。

trans.cn: giao nộp, đầu hàng; từ bỏ, từ bỏ, từ chức
trans.cn_source: 交出，让出；放弃，抛弃，辞去

trans.cn: Give up: tự nguyện từ bỏ hoặc từ bỏ (cái gì đó); ngừng làm hoặc thử một cái gì đó
trans.cn_source: 放弃：自愿放弃或放弃（某事物）；停止做或尝试某事。

sentences.c: He counselled them to give up the plan.
sentences.cn_source: 他建议他们放弃此项计划。

sentences.c: They'll have to give up completely on certain of their studies.
sentences.cn_source: 他们将不得不完全放弃某些课程。

sentences.c: You ought to give up smoking.
sentences.cn_source: 你应该戒烟。

trans.cn: với
trans.cn_source: 和…一起

sentences.c: Whatever the majority decided I was prepared to go along with.
sentences.cn_source: 不论多数人做何决定，我都准备好了遵从。

sentences.c: Leaders don't force other people but convince them to go along with them.
sentences.cn_source: 领导者不会强迫其他人赞同自己，但能说服别人。

sentences.c: I don't think it's vital to label GM ingredients in food, but I also wouldn't be against it—and industry would be smart to go along with labeling, just as a way of removing fears about the technology.
sentences.cn_source: 我不认为在食品中标注转基因成分是至关重要的，但我也不会反对——整个食品行业跟着贴标签的做法是明智的，这只是一种消除对这项技术的恐惧的方法。

sentences.cn_source: 我应该节食/涨工资。

sentences.c: To make myself look pretty again, I decide to go on a diet.
sentences.cn_source: 为了让自己更漂亮，我决定减肥。

trans.cn: Chuyển đổi thành những thứ mới hoặc cách làm mới: Đề cập đến việc thay đổi những thứ hoặc cách làm hiện có và chuyển sang những thứ mới hoặc cách làm mới.

sentences.cn_source: 他因试图越过上级官员而遭严斥。

sentences.cn_source: 我会下地狱吗？

sentences.cn_source: 这太糟糕了，我想他去地狱。

sentences.cn_source: 我必须承认我很不愿意同他打官司。

sentences.cn_source: 她决定去法院起诉丈夫以解决争端。

sentences.cn_source: 据来自辽宁人民律师事务所的夏琳（音）表示称，这样的合同是无效的，因为这样的安排可能会被视为违背了道德法则。

trans.cn: Đi sai đường; thất bại, đi sai
trans.cn_source: 走错路；失败，出毛病

sentences.c: The relationship started to go wrong when they moved abroad.
sentences.cn_source: 移居国外后，他们的关系开始出现问题了。

sentences.c: But then things started to go wrong.
sentences.cn_source: 但是，事情从此开始走向错误。

sentences.c: We do know that, when the balance is upset, things tend to go wrong.
sentences.cn_source: 我们知道，一旦平衡遭到破坏，事物就会偏离正轨。

trans.cn: giữ chặt; dựa vào, tìm đến sự giúp đỡ
trans.cn_source: 紧紧握住；依靠，求助于

sentences.c: The driver was unable to hang on to his lead.
sentences.cn_source: 这位车手没能守住自己的领先地位。

sentences.c: You can try to hang on to it or you can get over it.
sentences.cn_source: 你可以尝试一直想着它或者跨越它。

sentences.c: Don't allow yourself to hang on to any of these excuses.
sentences.cn_source: 不要让自己执着于这些借口了。

trans.cn: cúp máy; cúp máy (điện thoại); trì hoãn, trì hoãn

trans.cn: Cúp máy: là việc đặt điện thoại trở lại điện thoại hoặc cúp điện thoại sau khi cuộc gọi kết thúc.

trans.cn: Trì hoãn: Trì hoãn hoặc hoãn lại một cái gì đó.
trans.cn_source: 延迟，拖延：指推迟或拖延某事的进行。

sentences.c: Perhaps her ladyship would like to hang up her own clothes today!
sentences.cn_source: 尊贵的夫人今天也许愿意动手自己把衣服挂起来吧！

sentences.c: I have to hang up.
sentences.cn_source: 我不得不挂机了。

sentences.cn_source: 他们要求实验人员挂断电话。

sentences.cn_source: 我本以为它在这个角落，但我好像弄错了。

sentences.cn_source: 你知不知道当你把名片留与仆人时，为了暗示你来拜访过主人给他请安，你必须折叠名片的哪一角？

trans.cn: có thể truy cập được, có thể truy cập được
trans.cn_source: 可接近，可进入

sentences.c: They want their parents to have access to affordable long-term care.
sentences.cn_source: 他们希望他们的父母可以得到负担得起的长期看护。

sentences.c: We pay a fee to have access to the Internet.
sentences.cn_source: 我们支付费用接入互联网。

sentences.c: This doesn't actually require you to have access to a network.
sentences.cn_source: 这并不会实际要求您能够访问网络。

trans.cn: đối phó với nó
trans.cn_source: 应付过去

sentences.c: ICBC appears to have an edge.
sentences.cn_source: 目前工商银行似乎占有一定优势。

sentences.c: Therefore you need to optimize constantly your websites and to have an edge over others you need to do something different and unique.
sentences.cn_source: 因此，你需要优化你的网站，并不断有其他优势对你需要做一些不同的和独特的。

sentences.c: Today, however, you need only two things in order to have an automatic edge: cash and courage.
sentences.cn_source: 不过现在，你只需要两样东西就能自然而然地获得优势；那就是现金和勇气。

trans.cn: có tác động đến
trans.cn_source: 对…有影响

sentences.c: Changing the clocks, however, does not actually increase the amount of driving done in the dark, so it is unlikely to have any effect on Benovia's automobile accident rate.
sentences.cn_source: 然而，改变时钟实际上并不会增加在黑暗中驾驶的时间，所以它不太可能对 Benovia 的交通事故率有任何影响。

sentences.c: A country's capacity to produce wealth depends upon many factors, most of which have an effect on one another.
sentences.cn_source: 一个国家创造财富的能力取决于许多因素，其中大多数因素相互影响。

sentences.c: Few stop to think about the effect these devices may have on house guests.
sentences.cn_source: 很少有人会停下来思考这些设备可能对家中客人产生什么影响。

trans.cn: (áp dụng cho...)
trans.cn_source: （对…）适用

sentences.c: Yet I also know that too much of a good thing can be rough, especially for young kids who hold themselves to impossibly high standards.
sentences.cn_source: 然而我还知道太过追求优秀有时会让人难受。尤其对于那些给自己制定过高标准的小孩子来说。

sentences.c: Central Banks are not only likely to keep their policy rates on hold for the foreseeable future, they may, for good measure, buy more bonds themselves.
sentences.cn_source: 在可以预见的将来，央行不止很可能将搁置利率变动的政策，再三考虑之后，他们还可能会自己购买更多的债券。

sentences.c: Are you equipped to have and hold and develop what you desire for good purposes?
sentences.cn_source: 你是否准备好了拥有并实现你所渴望的美好结果？

sentences.c: We've asked the neighbours to keep an eye on the house for us while we are away.
sentences.cn_source: 我们已请邻居在我们离开时帮我们照看一下房子。

sentences.c: My parents set up a camera to keep an eye on me.
sentences.cn_source: 我的父母安装了一个摄像头来监督我。

sentences.c: Such stations will also be able to keep an eye on what is happening inside buildings, including offices.
sentences.cn_source: 这些监测站还将能够密切关注包括办公室在内的建筑物内发生的情况。

sentences.cn_source: 他大步走开了，她感到很难跟上他。

sentences.c: The earnings of the average American have failed to keep pace with the rate of inflation.
sentences.cn_source: 一般美国人的收入跟不上通货膨胀的速度。

sentences.c: Overlords' income, despite the increase in rice production among their tenant farmers, failed to keep pace with their expenses.
sentences.cn_source: 尽管佃农的稻米产量有所增加，但地主们的收入仍跟不上他们的支出。

sentences.cn_source: 问题出在纪律上，或者更确切地说，是学校缺乏纪律。

sentences.cn_source: 对政府管理经济的能力缺乏信心。

sentences.cn_source: 他以前根本就从来不笑。

sentences.cn_source: 珍妮只好自嘲自己的愚蠢。

sentences.c: Don't be unhappy if the people seem to laugh at your mistakes.
sentences.cn_source: 如果人们似乎在嘲笑你的错误，不要不高兴。

sentences.cn_source: 你应该为将来积蓄些钱。

sentences.cn_source: 在支付所有的开支以后，他们每月能积蓄十五元。

sentences.cn_source: 撒母耳对厨役说:" 我交给你收存的那一分祭肉现在可以拿来。"

sentences.c: People will accept suffering that can be shown to lead to a greater good.
sentences.cn_source: 人们将会容忍能被证明会带来更大利益的苦难。

sentences.cn_source: 单词是学习英语的基本功，所以你必须从单词开始（当然这要视你的水平而定），但是我也不建议…

sentences.c: It makes more sense to learn the same way your brain is designed, by connecting ideas together into a web, rather than trying to store them with rote memorization.
sentences.cn_source: 使用构建你大脑的那种方式——将所有知识连结成一个网络，会比用死记硬背将知识储存起来的方式，更行得通。

sentences.cn_source: 她的收入养活一个孩子几乎都不够，更不用说三个了。

sentences.cn_source: 这个12岁的小孩能够得着踏板都令人难以置信，更不用说开汽车了。

sentences.cn_source: 杰佩托师傅为了惩罚他的恶作剧，让他一个人呆了一上午。

sentences.cn_source: 如果你想成为一名科学家，你就必须放弃自己的信仰。

sentences.cn_source: 研究表明，消费者不愿放弃任何传统产品属性，比如便利性、价格和质量。

sentences.cn_source: 汉考克说：“人们在即时通话中撒谎的可能性，包括发信息或打电话，也比他们有时间考虑如何回复时的可能性大。”

sentences.c: I'm perfectly content just to lie in the sun.
sentences.cn_source: 我在阳光下躺着就感到非常满足。

sentences.cn_source: 去年早些时候，我喜欢躺在床上看视频，不喜欢学习。

trans.cn: làm sáng, tỏa sáng

sentences.cn_source: 这种灯从生长在一个木箱里的植物中获取能量，然后用它来点亮一个 LED 灯泡。

sentences.c: Electronic cigarettes - a safe way to light up?
sentences.cn_source: 电子香烟——安全的吸烟方式？

sentences.cn_source: 晚上忘记开车灯的司机常常出车祸。

trans.cn: Sống tiếp

sentences.c: For example, they don't like to live on the thirteenth floor.
sentences.cn_source: 例如，他们不喜欢住在第十三层楼。

sentences.c: They are still having to live on very low incomes.
sentences.cn_source: 他们仍然不得不靠微薄的收入为生。

sentences.c: The family was forced to live on credit from local merchants.
sentences.cn_source: 这家人不得不靠向当地的商家赊账过活。

sentences.cn_source: 作为一个API请求的例子，您将发出一个请求，为经过身份认证的用户检索好友。

sentences.c: The reason for this (as mentioned earlier) is that with raw sockets you need to establish a new connection for every request that you make to the server.
sentences.cn_source: 其原因(早些时候曾经提到过)是，用原始套接字，您需要为您向服务器作的每个请求建立一个新连接。

trans.cn: Có tác động, giữ vai trò quan trọng
trans.cn_source: 有影响，起（重要）作用

sentences.c: I wanted to make a difference in the world somehow, but I had no idea how to do that.
sentences.cn_source: 我想以某种方式在世界上有所作为，但我不知道该怎么做。

sentences.c: Want to make a difference to our planet?
sentences.cn_source: 想要改变我们的星球吗？

sentences.c: Tom wants to make a difference to the education system.
sentences.cn_source: 汤姆想改变教育体系。

trans.cn: Đoán
trans.cn_source: 猜测

sentences.c: Would it be beyond a philosopher's research, think ye, gentlemen, to analyse that child's nature, and, from its make and mould, to give a shrewd guess at the father?
sentences.cn_source: 先生们，请你们想一想，耍分析这孩子的天性，要根据她的体态和气质来对她的父亲作出聪明的猜测，是不是超出了哲学家的研究范畴了呢？

sentences.c: More precisely, the TTS engine can make a pretty good guess at pronouncing most anything you can spell and give it, but the recognizer must have a pronunciation for the words to be recognized.
sentences.cn_source: 更精确地说是，TTS引擎可以比较准确地猜到你能拼写出的任何词的发音，并将这种发音赋予该词，但识别器却必须有要识别的词的发音。

sentences.c: Experienced photographers guess pretty well at the settings that will work in a given environment, but even they check to make sure.
sentences.cn_source: 有经验的摄影师们可以在特定环境下估计出基本准确的参数来进行拍摄，但即使是他们，也会靠查看照片来确认。

trans.cn: Cam kết; sự cống hiến, sự cống hiến
trans.cn_source: 承诺；献身于，投入

sentences.c: He questioned the government's commitment to peace and called on it to make a gesture of good will.
sentences.cn_source: 他质疑政府的和平承诺，并呼吁其摆出善意姿态。

sentences.c: She doesn't want to make a big emotional commitment to Steve at the moment.
sentences.cn_source: 她不想在此刻对史蒂夫在感情上作出重大的承诺。

sentences.c: What sort of commitment do I have to make to use this treatment?
sentences.cn_source: 我需要做出什么样的承诺才能使用这种治疗方法?

trans.cn: (tài sản) chuyển nhượng, bàn giao; chuyển đổi, làm lại
trans.cn_source: （财产）转让，移交；改造，重做

sentences.c: He asked the tailor to make over his dress.
sentences.cn_source: 他请裁缝为他改做衣服。

sentences.c: Never try to make over your wife or husband.
sentences.cn_source: 永远不要试图改造你的老婆或老公。

sentences.c: Clay hated the abolitionists and the great noise they were beginning to make over slavery.
sentences.cn_source: 克莱憎恨废奴主义者和他们所带来的噪声，他们正在奴役他人。

trans.cn: có ý nghĩa
trans.cn_source: 有意义

sentences.c: To make sense, these figures should not be looked at in isolation.
sentences.cn_source: 这些数据不应孤立起来看，否则就没有意义。

sentences.c: They tried to make sense of her mumblings.
sentences.cn_source: 他们试图听明白她在嘟哝些什么。

sentences.c: Provided you didn't try to make sense of it, it sounded beautiful.
sentences.cn_source: 只要你不试图理解，它听起来是美的。

trans.cn: (gồm các bộ phận), được cấu thành (của toàn bộ); bịa đặt, hư cấu
trans.cn_source: （由部分）组成，构成（全体）；捏造，虚构

sentences.c: Everyone gets a chance to make up tests.
sentences.cn_source: 每个人都有一次补考的机会。

sentences.c: We need one more person to make up a team.
sentences.cn_source: 我们还需要一个人才能组成一个队。

sentences.c: They have nineteen days to make up their minds.
sentences.cn_source: 他们有十九天的时间来做出决定。

trans.cn: quyết định đi
trans.cn_source: 下决心

sentences.c: Irresolution means reluctance or an inability to make up one's mind.
sentences.cn_source: 优柔寡断指犹豫不决，举棋不定不愿或不能决定。

sentences.c: Look upon this story as a means of limbering up one's senses, one's attitude and one's mind to make them pliable and receptive.
sentences.cn_source: 这个故事可以让人的知觉、态度和心智变得柔韧、灵活和敏感，更容易接受新的事物。

trans.cn: Vô ích
trans.cn_source: 无济于事

trans.cn: Không có kết quả: Cho biết những nỗ lực hoặc cố gắng không mang lại kết quả.
trans.cn_source: 毫无结果：表示努力或尝试没有取得任何成果。

sentences.c: His efforts were to no avail.
sentences.cn_source: 他的努力是徒劳的。

sentences.c: The doctors tried everything to keep him alive but to no avail.
sentences.cn_source: 医生千方百计想使他活下来，但无济于事。

sentences.c: He had the receptionist almost jumping through hoops for him. But to no avail.
sentences.cn_source: 他让接待员为他几乎饱经折磨，但根本没有用。

trans.cn: có lợi cho ai đó
trans.cn_source: 对某人有利

trans.cn: Be có lợi cho ai đó: Nó có nghĩa là có lợi hoặc có lợi cho ai đó.
trans.cn_source: 对某人有利：表示对某人有益或有利。

sentences.c: To have the license number of one's automobile as low as possible is a social advantage in America.
sentences.cn_source: 为自己的汽车领一块尽可能小号码的车牌，在美国是表示社会上的优越地位的。

sentences.c: Died basically, unless they have infinite STH used to one's own advantage.
sentences.cn_source: 基本死了，除非他们有无限的资本。

sentences.c: To get away from one's working environment is, in a sense, to get away from one's self; and this is often the chief advantage of travel and change.
sentences.cn_source: 从某种意义上，离开自己的工作环境即是离开原先的那个自己，这是旅行带来的一大主要的好处。

trans.cn: mở; bắt đầu, mở ra, phát triển; nói chuyện thẳng thắn
trans.cn_source: 打开；开办，开辟，开发；坦诚地谈话

sentences.c: Lorna found that people were willing to open up to her.
sentences.cn_source: 洛娜发现人们愿意向她敞开心扉畅谈。

sentences.c: It helps to discuss your problems but I find it hard to open up.
sentences.cn_source: 与人谈谈自己面临的问题固然有益，但我觉得有些话很难说得出口。

sentences.c: Several customers were waiting when I arrived to open up the shop.
sentences.cn_source: 我到店里开门时，几个顾客已在等侯。

trans.cn: quyết định không tham gia vào..., quyết định rút lui (từ...)
trans.cn_source: 决定不参加…，决定（从…）退出

sentences.c: The wrong kind of leadership will lead to what Cialdini calls "captainitis, the regrettable tendency of team members to opt out of team responsibilities that are properly their."
sentences.cn_source: 错误的领导方式会导致西奥迪尼所说的“队长病”，即团队成员选择逃避本应属于他们的团队责任，这是一种令人遗憾的倾向。

sentences.c: Critics say the digital access codes represent the same profit seeking ethos of the textbook business, and are even harder for students to opt out of.
sentences.cn_source: 批评人士说，数字接入码代表着教科书行业同样的逐利风气，让学生更难选择退出。

sentences.c: Critics say the digital access codes represent the same profit-seeking ethos of the textbook business, and are even harder for students to opt out of.
sentences.cn_source: 批评人士说，数字准入码等同于教育行业的逐利风气，其让学生更难抽身其中。

trans.cn: Lưu ý
trans.cn_source: 注意

trans.cn: Chú ý: Chú ý đến điều gì đó, tập trung vào điều gì đó.
trans.cn_source: 注意：关注某事物，集中精力在某事物上。

sentences.c: How to pay attention to mental health?
sentences.cn_source: 怎样关注健康呢？

sentences.c: Teachers need to pay attention to students.
sentences.cn_source: 教师需要注意学生。

sentences.c: It's better to pay attention to your spelling.
sentences.cn_source: 最好注意你的拼写。

trans.cn: trả nợ; không vô ích
trans.cn_source: 偿还；没有白费

sentences.c: I need to pay off all my debts before I leave the country.
sentences.cn_source: 我得在离开该国前偿清所有债务。

sentences.c: It would take him the rest of his life to pay off that loan.
sentences.cn_source: 还清那笔贷款将花费他的余生。

sentences.c: The firm will be able to pay off its debts and still turn a modest profit.
sentences.cn_source: 该公司将能够还清其债务，而且还会稍有赢利。

trans.cn: trả giá
trans.cn_source: 付出代价

sentences.c: He's quite willing to pay the price I ask.
sentences.cn_source: 他很愿意照我的要价付钱。

sentences.c: I know I have to pay the price.
sentences.cn_source: 我知道我会付出代价。

sentences.c: As long as you are willing to pay the price.
sentences.cn_source: 只要你能付得起他们的价格。

trans.cn: tích lũy; (chỉ một số phương tiện) va chạm vào nhau
trans.cn_source: 累积；（指若干车辆）碰撞在一起

sentences.c: When the air gets closer to the shore, it's slowed down by the land and starts to pile up.
sentences.cn_source: 当空气接近海岸时，陆地会减缓它的速度并使其在此堆积。

sentences.c: But we don't want B to pile up.
sentences.cn_source: 但我们不想让B积聚起来。

sentences.c: Slowly, the money began to pile up.
sentences.cn_source: 慢慢地，钱凑齐了。

trans.cn: để ghim; kiềm chế; để ghim xuống; để giải thích chính xác
trans.cn_source: 钉住；使受约束，牵制；准确说明

sentences.c: It has taken until now to pin down its exact location.
sentences.cn_source: 一直到现在才确定了它的准确位置。

sentences.c: The cause of the disease is difficult to pin down precisely.
sentences.cn_source: 病因目前还难以解释清楚。

sentences.c: He set out with an apparently simple aim: to pin down the precise meaning of the concept of "information".
sentences.cn_source: 他的出发点显然很简单：确定“信息”这个概念的确切含义。

trans.cn: Để tạo điều kiện cho ai đó; mang lại lợi ích cho ai đó
trans.cn_source: 为某人谋方便；有利于某人

trans.cn: cầu xin; yêu cầu
trans.cn_source: 恳求；请求

sentences.c: He opens to speed a car on the road that day and the detection has to plea for help signal in front.
sentences.cn_source: 那天他开着奔驰车在路上，发现对面有个求救信号。

sentences.c: Mr Gyurcsany had a second plea: for eastern countries to secure early membership of the single currency.
sentences.cn_source: 此外久尔恰尼还提出了另一项请求，希望能确保东欧国家能早日加入单一货币体系。

sentences.c: They helped persuade the father of one murdered man to make a moving-and successful-plea for calm.
sentences.cn_source: 他们帮助说服了一名受害人的父亲，让他动容地呼吁民众平静下来——而且成功了。

trans.cn: Để hỗ trợ, cung cấp nhu yếu phẩm cho...
trans.cn_source: 赡养，为…提供必需品

trans.cn: Cung cấp, chăm sóc: cung cấp cho ai đó những nhu cầu thiết yếu hàng ngày, bao gồm thức ăn, chỗ ở, chăm sóc y tế, v.v.
trans.cn_source: 供养，照顾：为某人提供生活所需，包括食物、住所、医疗等。

trans.cn: Dự tính trước, đặt trước: Dự đoán một tình huống hoặc nhu cầu trong một kế hoạch hoặc sự sắp xếp.
trans.cn_source: 预先考虑，预留：在计划或安排中预先考虑到某种情况或需求。

sentences.c: The Strasbourg conference's main concern was to provide for the future.
sentences.cn_source: 斯特拉斯堡会议主要关注的是为未来做好准备。

sentences.c: I have done my share these last four years and now it is your turn to provide for her.
sentences.cn_source: 过去四年我尽了自己的一份力量，现在轮到你来养活她了。

sentences.c: She had tried to provide for the child elsewhere, and at last she had found a splendid chance for her.
sentences.cn_source: 她曾试图把这个孩子领到别的地方抚养，她终于找到了一个极好的机会。

trans.cn: cung cấp cho ai đó…
trans.cn_source: 给某人提供…

sentences.c: With provision of submersibles, to train pilots for underwater vehicle. Provide professional training services to vehicle's owners or somebody interested in underwater operation.
sentences.cn_source: 在提供潜水器产品的同时，培训潜水器操作驾驶人员，为潜水器业主或者有志于水下操作驾驶的个人提供专业的培训服务。

trans.cn: tháo dỡ; lật đổ
trans.cn_source: 拆除；推翻

trans.cn: Phá dỡ, phá dỡ: đề cập đến việc loại bỏ hoặc phá hủy các tòa nhà, công trình, v.v.
trans.cn_source: 拆除，拆毁：指将建筑物、结构等拆除或拆毁。

trans.cn: Kéo xuống, kéo xuống: Dùng lực để kéo hoặc kéo vật gì đó xuống.
trans.cn_source: 拉下，拖下：用力将某物向下拉或拖。

sentences.c: It is easier to pull down than to build up.
sentences.cn_source: 拆房容易盖房难。

sentences.c: Michael continues trying to pull down on the pipe, but it won't budge.
sentences.cn_source: Michael继续试图撬动那条管道，但是根本没用。

sentences.c: I always have this wicked urge to pull down their pants when I see this "look".
sentences.cn_source: 当我看到这些人，我忍不住想把他们的裤子拉下来。

trans.cn: kết thúc hoặc bãi bỏ một cái gì đó
trans.cn_source: 结束或废除某事务

sentences.c: There have been continual demands to put an end to this situation.
sentences.cn_source: 人们不断要求要结束这种局面。

sentences.c: Under the new Northern Territory law, an adult patient can request death—probably by a deadly injection or pill—to put an end to suffering.
sentences.cn_source: 根据新的北领地法律，成年病人可以要求死亡——通过注射或服用致命药丸来结束痛苦。

sentences.c: I felt that I had got to put an end to that dreadful noise.
sentences.cn_source: 我深感有必要结束那折磨人的噪音。

trans.cn: Đặt sang một bên để lưu trữ
trans.cn_source: 放在一边，撇开储存

trans.cn: Đặt sang một bên: Tạm thời đặt một cái gì đó sang một bên để nó không được sử dụng hoặc xử lý nữa.
trans.cn_source: 放置一边：将某物暂时放在一边，不再使用或处理。

sentences.c: They decided to put aside their differences.
sentences.cn_source: 他们决定搁置双方的分歧。

sentences.c: In order to take advantage of these common-sense solutions, Americans will have to put aside their own attachment to the idea of smaller government and less regulation.
sentences.cn_source: 为了利用这些常识性的解决方案，美国人将不得不抛弃缩小政府规模和减少监管的想法。

sentences.c: The teachers in the program described how they found it difficult to put aside the immediate demands of others in order to give themselves the time they needed to develop their reflective skills.
sentences.cn_source: 参加这个项目的老师们描述了他们是如何发现自己很难把他人的即时需求放在一边，以便有足够的时间来增强自己的反思技能。

trans.cn: hoãn lại; loại bỏ
trans.cn_source: 延期；消除

trans.cn: Trì hoãn, trì hoãn: Đề cập đến việc trì hoãn các kế hoạch hoặc sự sắp xếp đến một thời điểm sau đó.
trans.cn_source: 推迟，延迟：指将计划或安排推迟到以后的时间。

sentences.c: We've had to put off our wedding until September.
sentences.cn_source: 我们只得把婚期推迟到九月。

sentences.c: Mr. Bint has a propensity to put off decisions to the last minute.
sentences.cn_source: 宾特先生有一种将决定拖到最后一分钟的倾向。

sentences.c: Some believe this level of compensation is essentially a poison pill to put off any rival bidders.
sentences.cn_source: 一些人相信这种程度的补偿本质上是一个毒丸策略，旨在阻止一切竞标对手。

trans.cn: để quyên góp...; nâng cao, nâng cao
trans.cn_source: 提出以供…；举起，抬起

trans.cn: Xây dựng: Để dựng lên một cái gì đó, thường là một tòa nhà hoặc công trình kiến ​​trúc tạm thời.
trans.cn_source: 搭建，建造：将某物建立起来，通常指临时性的建筑或结构。

trans.cn: Chỗ ở: Cung cấp chỗ ở tạm thời cho ai đó.
trans.cn_source: 提供住宿：为某人提供临时的住宿。

trans.cn: Khoan dung: chịu đựng ai đó hoặc điều gì đó, đặc biệt là điều gì đó khó chịu.
trans.cn_source: 忍受，容忍：容忍某人或某事，尤指令人不悦的事情。

sentences.c: She was in no mood to put up with Blanche's carping.
sentences.cn_source: 她当时没有心情容忍布兰奇的吹毛求疵。

sentences.c: My girlfriend Geraldine is a saint to put up with me.
sentences.cn_source: 我的女友杰拉尔丁是个能包容我的圣人。

sentences.c: I'm not going to put up with their smoking any longer.
sentences.cn_source: 我再也不能容忍他们抽烟了。

trans.cn: chịu đựng, chịu đựng
trans.cn_source: 忍受，容忍

trans.cn: Chịu đựng: Hành động bao dung hoặc chịu đựng một cái gì đó hoặc một ai đó.
trans.cn_source: 忍受：指容忍或忍耐某事或某人的行为。

trans.cn: Khoan dung: Chấp nhận hoặc chịu đựng sự hiện diện hoặc hành vi của một cái gì đó hoặc ai đó.
trans.cn_source: 容忍：指接受或容忍某事或某人的存在或行为。

sentences.c: She was in no mood to put up with Blanche's carping.
sentences.cn_source: 她当时没有心情容忍布兰奇的吹毛求疵。

sentences.c: I'm not going to put up with their smoking any longer.
sentences.cn_source: 我再也不能容忍他们抽烟了。

sentences.c: It's a crying shame that police have to put up with these mindless attacks.
sentences.cn_source: 警察不得不容忍这些无谓的攻击，真是件太令人遗憾的事。

trans.cn: phản ứng lại; thay đổi hành động của một người do ảnh hưởng
trans.cn_source: 对…做出反应；因受影响而改变行动

sentences.c: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
sentences.cn_source: 在过去十年左右的时间里，科技的进步让 Zara 、H&M 和优衣库等大众品牌能够更快地对潮流做出反应，更准确地预测需求。

sentences.c: Someone allergic to milk is likely to react to cheese.
sentences.cn_source: 对牛奶过敏的人可能会对奶酪也有不良反应。

sentences.c: I just don't know how to react to it.
sentences.cn_source: 我都不知道自己应该如何反应才好。

trans.cn: Đề cập đến, đề cập đến; tham khảo, tham khảo
trans.cn_source: 提到，涉及；参考，查阅

sentences.c: Do you think it's reliable to refer to rating websites?
sentences.cn_source: 你认为参考评级网站可靠吗？

sentences.c: And then there those who, not knowing what questions are coming at them, and having no resources to refer to, can freeze.
sentences.cn_source: 然后，那些不知道会遇到何种题目，也没有资源可以参考的人，可能会整个人呆在那里。

sentences.c: I promised not to refer to the matter again.
sentences.cn_source: 我答应过再不提这事了。

trans.cn: suy nghĩ cẩn thận, suy ngẫm
trans.cn_source: 仔细考虑，反思

sentences.c: She was left to reflect on the implications of her decision.
sentences.cn_source: 由她负责考虑她这个决定会牵扯哪些问题。

sentences.c: The start of a new year is a good time to reflect on the many achievements of the past.
sentences.cn_source: 新年伊始正是回顾过去许多成绩的好时候。

sentences.c: Over the next few years many people had occasion to reflect on the truth of his warnings.
sentences.cn_source: 在随后的几年里许多人有机会反思他那些警告的真相。

trans.cn: Nghiên cứu
trans.cn_source: 研究

trans.cn: Tiến hành nghiên cứu: Đề cập đến việc tiến hành điều tra và nghiên cứu chuyên sâu về một chủ đề hoặc vấn đề nhất định.
trans.cn_source: 进行……的研究：指对某个主题或问题进行深入的调查和研究。

sentences.c: But what sets it apart is further responsibility to research into upcoming technological trends with regard to the organization's growth.
sentences.cn_source: 但其不同之处是研究组织的未来增长趋势的进一步职责。

sentences.c: Like last week in the library, we decided to split up the research into 3 parts and then each of us was supposed to find sources in the library for our parts.
sentences.cn_source: 就像上周在图书馆，我们决定把研究分成三部分，然后我们每个人本应该在图书馆为各自的部分寻找资料。

sentences.c: I'm going to talk today about research into a particular species of bird—the New Caledonian crow, whose natural habitat is small islands in the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.cn_source: 我今天要讲的是对一种特殊鸟类的研究——新喀里多尼亚乌鸦，它的自然栖息地是太平洋上的小岛。

trans.cn: trả lời, trả lời; phản ứng lại, đáp lại
trans.cn_source: 作答，回答；对…作出反应，响应

sentences.c: The best way to respond to a flame is to ignore it.
sentences.cn_source: 回应攻击性电子邮件的最好方式就是置之不理。

sentences.c: The world community has been slow to respond to the crisis.
sentences.cn_source: 国际社会对该危机的反应向来迟缓。

sentences.c: You can rely on him to respond to a challenge.
sentences.cn_source: 你可以信赖他，他懂得应付挑战。

trans.cn: phụ thuộc vào, dựa vào
trans.cn_source: 依赖，依靠

sentences.c: Perhaps I created laurels to rest upon.
sentences.cn_source: 也许，我造了长青树好在上面休息。

sentences.c: Then Abraham said, depart, depart from me, for I desire to rest upon my couch.
sentences.cn_source: 然后亚伯拉罕说，离开，离开我，因为我渴望休息后，我躺在沙发上。

sentences.c: Gannet - to subsist by the wings of his virtue and merit, having little land to rest upon.
sentences.cn_source: 塘鹅-以自己美德和功绩为党羽而继续生存的人，流落而没有定所。

trans.cn: xảy ra; nguyên nhân do, bắt nguồn từ
trans.cn_source: 发生；因…引起，起因于

sentences.c: The complications frequently accompanying diabetes, such as impairment of vision and of kidney function, are now thought to result from the lack of continuous control of blood glucose concentrations.
sentences.cn_source: 现在认为糖尿病经常伴有的并发症，如视力和肾功能损害，是由于缺乏对血糖浓度的持续控制所致。

sentences.c: The condition appears to result from the cumulative effect of a number of factors, with atmospheric pollutants the principal culprits.
sentences.cn_source: 这种情况似乎是由许多因素的累积的结果，而大气污染物是主要的罪魁祸首。

sentences.c: In the case of NBA players, their increase in height appears to result from the increasingly common practice of recruiting players from all over the world.
sentences.cn_source: 拿 NBA 球员来说，他们身高的增加似乎是由于从世界各地招募球员的做法越来越普遍。

trans.cn: loại trừ
trans.cn_source: 排除

trans.cn: Loại trừ: Một quyết định hoặc tuyên bố chính thức rằng điều gì đó là không thể hoặc điều gì đó hoặc ai đó không phù hợp.
trans.cn_source: 排除：官方决定或声明某事不可能发生，或者某事物或某人不合适。

sentences.c: He refused to rule out the possibility of a tax increase.
sentences.cn_source: 他拒绝排除增税的可能性。

sentences.c: Physical and eye examinations, with special attention to cardiac and blood-pressure problems, should be performed annually to rule out serious medical conditions.
sentences.cn_source: 每年应进行身体和眼睛检查，特别注意心脏和血压问题，以排除严重的疾病。

sentences.c: She refused to rule out speculation that this was General Younes.
sentences.cn_source: 有猜测指这人就是尤尼斯将军，对此她拒绝加以排除。

trans.cn: kiệt sức
trans.cn_source: 用尽

sentences.c: Fears that the world was about to run out of fuel proved groundless.
sentences.cn_source: 担心地球燃料即将用尽被证明是没有根据的。

sentences.c: It is easy for families to run out of money before the weekly giro arrives.
sentences.cn_source: 每周直接转账救济支票还未到钱便花光的情况许多家庭都容易出现。

sentences.c: Soon, the money began to run out and they couldn't afford the lessons anymore.
sentences.cn_source: 很快，钱被用完了，他们再也负担不起这些课程了。

trans.cn: hy sinh; hy sinh cho; thua vì
trans.cn_source: 向…献祭；为…而牺牲；为…而失去

sentences.c: Samuel replied, "Yes, in peace; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD."
sentences.cn_source: 他说：“为平安来的，我是给耶和华献祭。”

sentences.c: It's a question of how much you're prepared to sacrifice to get inside television.
sentences.cn_source: 为了进入电视圈，你多大程度上做好了牺牲的准备。

sentences.c: The LORD said, "Take a heifer with you and say, 'I have come to sacrifice to the LORD."'
sentences.cn_source: 耶和华说：“你可以带一只牛犊去，就说：‘我来是要向耶和华献祭。”’

trans.cn: Tìm kiếm, tìm kiếm, khám phá
trans.cn_source: 搜寻，搜查，探察

sentences.c: You can use a directory service to search for people on the Internet.
sentences.cn_source: 你可以使用目录服务在因特网上搜索人。

sentences.c: For example, police use it to search for bad guys.
sentences.cn_source: 例如，警察用它来搜索坏人。

sentences.c: Thousands of people come to search for the scenes (场景) in the novel.
sentences.cn_source: 成千上万的人前来寻找小说中的场景。

trans.cn: chiếm giữ; sở hữu
trans.cn_source: 抓住；占有

sentences.c: The wrestlers try to seize hold of each other.
sentences.cn_source: 摔跤选手未能抓住对手的胳膊。

sentences.c: As you gradually learn to do this, even the most turbulent emotions fail to seize hold of you and instead dissolve, as wild waves rise and rear and sink back into the calm of the ocean.
sentences.cn_source: 当你慢慢做此修炼时，就算是最强烈的情绪也无法纠缠你，也会溶化；如同巨浪生起、高耸，而又沉没回到海洋的宁静中。

sentences.c: To seize hold of the market, game companies and operator must go into investigation and analyze the datum by the Numbers. It is the premise to decide the capacity and requirement of the servers.
sentences.cn_source: 游戏公司和运营商要正确地把握市场导向，需要对市场进行调查和系统化分析，以确定游戏服务器容量和需求。

trans.cn: thích hợp cho
trans.cn_source: 适合

trans.cn: To action as: đóng một vai trò nào đó hoặc đóng một vai trò nhất định.
trans.cn_source: 充当，担任：扮演某种角色或起到某种作用。

sentences.c: She was elected to serve as secretary of the local party.
sentences.cn_source: 她当选为地方党组织的书记。

sentences.c: Her job was to serve as a gatekeeper, a human shield for the technicians.
sentences.cn_source: 她的工作是当一个看门人——技术员的人盾。

sentences.c: Outside directors are supposed to serve as helpful, yet less biased, advisers on a firm's board.
sentences.cn_source: 外部董事应当成为公司董事会得力又客观的顾问。

trans.cn: đặt sang một bên, đặt sang một bên; bỏ qua, bỏ qua
trans.cn_source: 留出，拨出；忽视，不顾

sentences.c: She tries to set aside some money every month.
sentences.cn_source: 她每个月都尽量存点钱。

sentences.c: He urged the participants to set aside minor differences for the sake of achieving peace.
sentences.cn_source: 他敦促与会者把小分歧抛于脑后，以求实现和平。

sentences.c: It's much wise to set aside some time to accompany parents or do something more meaningful.
sentences.cn_source: 留出一些时间陪伴父母或做一些更有意义的事情是很明智的。

trans.cn: Khởi hành, khởi hành; công bố, công bố; hiển thị, hiển thị
trans.cn_source: 出发，起程；宣布，发表；展示，陈列

sentences.c: People now in many big cities have to set out early to avoid the heavy traffic in the morning.
sentences.cn_source: 现在许多大城市的人们不得不早早地出发以避开早晨的交通拥挤。

sentences.c: The troops are about to set out.
sentences.cn_source: 部队就要出发了。

sentences.c: The simplest definition of success is to set out to do something and to succeed in doing it.
sentences.cn_source: 成功最简单的定义就是着手去做一件事，并成功地完成它。

trans.cn: Thành lập, thành lập; thiết lập, đề xuất
trans.cn_source: 设立，建立；建立，提出

trans.cn: Thành lập: chính thức thành lập một công ty, tổ chức, hệ thống, phương thức làm việc mới, v.v.
trans.cn_source: 建立：正式建立一个新的公司、组织、系统、工作方式等。

sentences.c: We decided to set up camp for the night.
sentences.cn_source: 我们决定搭帐篷过夜。

sentences.c: The machine is a doddle to set up and use.
sentences.cn_source: 这机器的安装和使用都很简单。

sentences.c: Our first task is to set up a communications system.
sentences.cn_source: 我们的首项任务是架设通信系统。

trans.cn: tránh, tránh; chấp thuận
trans.cn_source: 躲开，回避；赞成

sentences.c: You don't need to shy away from the honor. You deserve it in your own right.
sentences.cn_source: 你不用躲这个荣誉，你有资格得到它。

sentences.c: Bad: It is easy to shy away from the XML Schema syntax when it is unfamiliar.
sentences.cn_source: 不好的方法：当您对 XML Schema 语法不熟悉的时候，就很容易出现回避它们的情况。

sentences.c: Many other countries and international organizations have begun to shy away from dam building.
sentences.cn_source: 许多国家和国际组织都已开始对修建大坝敬而远之。

trans.cn: vật thể
trans.cn_source: 反对

sentences.c: She had to sit down on the dry, hard ground and look down into the valley and all about her.
sentences.cn_source: 她不得不坐在干燥坚硬的地面上，俯视着山谷和周围的一切。

sentences.c: "Then we must invite her to sit down on the beautiful green lounge of grass," quietly answered the old man.
sentences.cn_source: “那我们就必须邀请她坐那张铺着绿草垫的漂亮长沙发了。”老人平静地回答。

sentences.c: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
sentences.cn_source: 他就吩咐众人坐在地上。

trans.cn: ở một mức độ nào đó
trans.cn_source: 在某种程度上

trans.cn: ở một mức độ nào đó; một phần
trans.cn_source: 在某种程度上；部分地

sentences.c: To some extent this was the truth.
sentences.cn_source: 在某种程度上这是事实。

sentences.c: To some extent what she argues is true.
sentences.cn_source: 她的论证在某种程度上是符合事实的。

sentences.c: Biography must to some extent delineate characters.
sentences.cn_source: 在某种程度上，传记一定要描述人物。

trans.cn: Phân loại, tổ chức
trans.cn_source: 分类，整理

sentences.c: Let's try to sort out the mess.
sentences.cn_source: 我们来收拾一下残局吧。

sentences.c: The police were called to sort out a domestic.
sentences.cn_source: 已叫警察来解决家庭纠纷。

sentences.c: We urged them to sort out the problem sooner rather than later.
sentences.cn_source: 我们敦促他们及早解决那个问题。

trans.cn: Sắp xếp, phân loại...
trans.cn_source: 整理，把…分类

sentences.c: Their specific task is to sort through the reams of information and try to determine what it means.
sentences.cn_source: 他们的具体任务就是将大量信息分类，并努力弄清其意思。

sentences.c: For group decision-making to work well, you need a way to sort through the various options they propose: and you need a mechanism to narrow down these options.
sentences.cn_source: 要想让团队决策发挥作用，你需要有一种方法来梳理他们提出的各种方案，你还需要一种机制来缩小这些选择的范围。

sentences.c: What's the best way to sort through the details on sunscreens?
sentences.cn_source: 如何整理一大堆关于防晒霜的信息？

trans.cn: nói về, đề cập đến
trans.cn_source: 谈起，提到

trans.cn: Đáng được đề cập: Quan trọng hoặc đủ quan trọng để đáng được đề cập.
trans.cn_source: 值得一提：足够重要或显著，值得一提。

sentences.c: She can speak German and French, not to speak of English.
sentences.cn_source: 她能说德语和法语，更不用说英语了。

sentences.c: They've got no friends to speak of.
sentences.cn_source: 他们没一个像样的朋友。

sentences.c: She's saved a little money but nothing to speak of.
sentences.cn_source: 她攒了一点钱，不过数目不值一提。

trans.cn: Ý nghĩa thật sâu sắc và ý nghĩa
trans.cn_source: 含义很深，很有意义

sentences.c: If they are at all questioning your love for them, this gesture is going to speak volumes to them, because they are probably very certain about how you feel about whatever it is you give up for them.
sentences.cn_source: 如果他们都质疑你对他们的爱是，这个姿态是想说卷的他们，因为他们可能是非常肯定的对你的感受不管它是你放弃了他们。

sentences.c: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
sentences.cn_source: 正如破译密码在西班牙的战争中有着更广泛的意义一样，他试图晋升的努力也充分说明了英国社会的情况。

sentences.c: The answers to these simple questions can speak volumes about complex psychological process.
sentences.cn_source: 对这些简单问题的回答，可以充分说明我们的心理过程。

trans.cn: Chuyên về
trans.cn_source: 专门从事

trans.cn: Chuyên môn hóa, chuyên môn hóa: đề cập đến việc có kiến ​​thức, kỹ năng hoặc kinh nghiệm chuyên môn trong một lĩnh vực hoặc hoạt động nhất định.
trans.cn_source: 专营，专门研究：指在某个领域或某种活动中具有专门的知识、技能或经验。

sentences.c: A small segment of the urban society started to specialize in nonagricultural tasks as a result of the city's role as a regional center.
sentences.cn_source: 由于该城市是区域的中心，城市社会中的一小部分人开始专门从事非农业工作。

sentences.c: A college education will enable me to specialize in a certain field of knowledge, such as medicine or law, preparing me to become a professional.
sentences.cn_source: 大学教育将使我能够专注于某些领域的知识，例如医学或法律，让我成为专业人士。

sentences.c: After I did my engineering degree, I began to specialize in computer technology.
sentences.cn_source: 读完工程学位后，我就开始专攻计算机技术。

trans.cn: suy nghĩ ; suy đoán ; đoán
trans.cn_source: 思索；推测，猜测

sentences.c: This has led scientists to speculate on the existence of other galaxies.
sentences.cn_source: 这就使得科学家推测还有其他星系存在。

sentences.c: He likes to speculate on the stock market.
sentences.cn_source: 他喜欢炒股。

sentences.c: He refused to speculate on the possible effects on relations between the two governments.
sentences.cn_source: 他拒绝猜测这对两国政府关系可能产生的影响。

trans.cn: (làm) tăng tốc
trans.cn_source: （使）加快速度

trans.cn: Tăng tốc: Xảy ra hoặc di chuyển nhanh hơn, hoặc làm điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc di chuyển nhanh hơn.
trans.cn_source: 加速：发生或移动更快，或使某事发生或移动更快。

sentences.c: Action had been taken to speed up the release of cheques.
sentences.cn_source: 已采取行动来加速支票的发放。

sentences.c: Increasing gravity is known to speed up the multiplication of cells.
sentences.cn_source: 为人所知的是，不断增加的重力会加速细胞数量的递增。

sentences.c: We become insensitive to our experience, which means we process less information, and time seems to speed up.
sentences.cn_source: 我们对自己的经历变得不敏感，这意味着我们处理的信息更少，而时间似乎在加速。

trans.cn: chia rẽ, tách rời; cãi vã, ly hôn
trans.cn_source: 分裂，分开；吵架，离婚

sentences.c: The band have reportedly decided to split up.
sentences.cn_source: 据说这个乐队已经决定解散。

sentences.c: Like last week in the library, we decided to split up the research into 3 parts and then each of us was supposed to find sources in the library for our parts.
sentences.cn_source: 就像上周在图书馆，我们决定把研究分成三部分，然后我们每个人本应该在图书馆为各自的部分寻找资料。

sentences.c: The salient question is whether to split up the user data into multiple table Spaces or not.
sentences.cn_source: 突出的问题在于是否要将用户数据分割到多个表空间中。

trans.cn: không có khả năng; không có hy vọng
trans.cn_source: 没有可能；没有希望

sentences.c: The main goal: to make sure that no matter which rung on the ladder a person occupies, they stand at least a fighting chance of making it to the rung above them - provided they truly deserve it.
sentences.cn_source: 主要目标是：以确保无论哪个响的阶梯上占有一个人，他们至少有战斗的机会使它向他们敲响以上-提供他们真正得到它。

sentences.c: There are too many "temples" and each has too many "deities". Veteran comrades stand in the way and younger people have no chance to come forward.
sentences.cn_source: 现在的庙很多，每个庙里的菩萨也很多，老同志盖住了，年轻人上不来。

trans.cn: quay lưng lại với ai, tránh xa ai
trans.cn_source: 转过脸去不理睬某人，避开某人

sentences.c: The trip is scheduled to start on December 21 in New York City and continue on to Milan, Prague, Paris, Bangkok and New Delhi before ending in Toronto on January 8.
sentences.cn_source: 这次旅行计划于12月21日在纽约开始，然后继续前往米兰、布拉格、巴黎、曼谷和新德里，1月8日在多伦多结束。

sentences.c: When it was near sunset, the doctor rose to start on his way down.
sentences.cn_source: 太阳快落山的时候，医生站了起来，开始往下走。

sentences.c: When are you going to start on your journey?
sentences.cn_source: 你们哪天去旅行啊？

trans.cn: dính vào, dính vào
trans.cn_source: 附着，粘住

sentences.c: Don't expect me to stick to the job just because it pays a few more bucks.
sentences.cn_source: 别指望我只为多挣几块钱就坚持工作下去。

sentences.c: She finds it impossible to stick to a diet.
sentences.cn_source: 饮食老受限制，她觉得受不了。

sentences.c: I managed to stick to the diet and keep off sweet foods.
sentences.cn_source: 我设法坚持节食，不吃甜食。

trans.cn: vẫn tồn tại; tiếp tục
trans.cn_source: 坚持；继续

sentences.c: They decided to stick with their original plan.
sentences.cn_source: 他们决定继续执行原来的计划。

sentences.c: More than half of Australian homes are still choosing to stick with their home phone.
sentences.cn_source: 超过一半的澳大利亚家庭仍然选择保留他们的座机。

sentences.c: If you love to swim or dance, you may find it easier to stick with an exercise program that is built around these activities.
sentences.cn_source: 如果你喜欢游泳或跳舞，你会发现更容易坚持以这些活动为基础的锻炼计划。

trans.cn: hấp thụ, hút ra, hút lên
trans.cn_source: 吸收，吸出，吸起

sentences.c: There wasn’t a Hoover in the world big enough to suck up all that shit.
sentences.cn_source: 世界上可没有足够大的真空吸尘器能把那些毒物吸光。

sentences.c: Another way would be growing algae in the ocean to suck up carbon dioxide.
sentences.cn_source: 另外一种办法是可以通过在海洋里种植藻类来吸收二氧化碳。

sentences.c: The heavier bodied base of the machine often remains still while the long hose moves around to suck up dirt.
sentences.cn_source: 它沉重的底座留在地上，而连接在上面的橡皮软管却能四处移动打扫灰尘。

sentences.cn_source: 搭车由于交通不便，时常要搭顺路的货车回家。一旦有车停下，就会有人争先恐后地攀爬而上。

trans.cn: lợi dụng; tận dụng
trans.cn_source: 利用；占…便宜

trans.cn: Khai thác: Đề cập đến việc lợi dụng một cơ hội hoặc tình huống để có được lợi ích hoặc lợi thế.
trans.cn_source: 利用：指利用某种机会或情况来获得好处或利益。

trans.cn: Lợi dụng: Lợi dụng hoàn cảnh hoặc điểm yếu của người khác để trục lợi cá nhân.
trans.cn_source: 占便宜：指利用某种情况或他人的弱点来获得个人利益。

trans.cn: Tận dụng cơ hội: là việc nắm bắt cơ hội để làm điều gì đó trong những hoàn cảnh nhất định.
trans.cn_source: 趁机：指在某种情况下抓住机会做某事。

sentences.c: The company is ideally placed to take advantage of the new legislation.
sentences.cn_source: 这家公司条件理想得很，恰好可以充分利用新法规。

sentences.c: It is surprising that it has taken people so long to take advantage of what is a win-win opportunity.
sentences.cn_source: 令人惊讶的是，人们花了那么长的时间才把一个双赢的机会利用起来。

sentences.c: I'm going to take advantage of this tour to explore the history of the castle.
sentences.cn_source: 我想利用这次旅行来探索这座城堡的历史。

trans.cn: tháo dỡ; tách rời
trans.cn_source: 拆散；拆开

sentences.c: The next step is to take apart the to get the piezoelectric ignitor.
sentences.cn_source: 下一步就是要采取除了得到压电电点火器。

sentences.c: The analyzer's job is to take apart a string of text and give you back a stream of tokens.
sentences.cn_source: 分析器的工作是分离一串文本并返回一个标号流。

sentences.c: But anything that's simple can't be destroyed in that way it has no parts to take apart.
sentences.cn_source: 但是任何简单的东西不会毁灭，因为它们没有部分，不会被拆开。

trans.cn: Để chăm sóc; để chăm sóc; để chăm sóc; để đối phó với

trans.cn: Chăm sóc, chăm sóc: Chịu trách nhiệm chăm sóc, quan tâm đến ai đó hoặc vật gì đó, đảm bảo sự an toàn và sức khỏe của mình.
trans.cn_source: 照顾，照料：负责照顾或照料某人或某物，确保其安全和健康。

sentences.c: We need to take care of our bodies.
sentences.cn_source: 我们需要照顾好自己的身体。

sentences.c: He's old enough to take care of himself.
sentences.cn_source: 他已经不小了，能照顾自己了。

sentences.c: Mark, you've got a good wife. You ought to take care of her.
sentences.cn_source: 马克，你娶了个好太太，应该好好照顾她啊。

trans.cn: hấp thụ; cho... vào; chấp nhận, chấp nhận
trans.cn_source: 吸收；让…进入；接纳，接受

trans.cn: Lừa dối: Lừa dối hoặc lừa dối ai đó theo một cách nào đó.
trans.cn_source: 欺骗：以某种方式欺骗或蒙骗某人。

sentences.c: They will certainly need to take in plenty of liquid.
sentences.cn_source: 他们会肯定需要吸收大量液体。

sentences.c: A mirror is hung opposite a window to take in the outside scenery.
sentences.cn_source: 一面镜子悬于窗子对面，以映出外面的风景。

sentences.c: When you reach the top of the mountain, you'll find it difficult to take in air.
sentences.cn_source: 当你到达山顶时，就会发现呼吸困难。

trans.cn: lưu ý, chú ý
trans.cn_source: 注意，留意

sentences.c: A couple of things to take note of here.
sentences.cn_source: 这儿需要注意几个事情。

sentences.c: Have the kindness to take note of my signature...
sentences.cn_source: 惠请留意我的签名。

sentences.c: This is a useful idiom to take note of — save and reload.
sentences.cn_source: 这是一个需要注意的有用习惯——保存和重新加载。

trans.cn: Có; giữ (công việc, v.v.); tuyển dụng
trans.cn_source: 具有；担任（工作等）；雇佣

sentences.cn_source: 我不愿意承担新的责任。

sentences.c: The bus stopped to take on more passengers.
sentences.cn_source: 公共汽车停下让其他乘客上车。

sentences.c: Events began to take on a more sinister aspect.
sentences.cn_source: 事情开始呈现较为不祥的征兆。

trans.cn: tiếp quản, tiếp quản; vận chuyển từ nơi này đến nơi khác
trans.cn_source: 接管，接任；把…从一处运到另一处

sentences.c: I'm going to take over the company one day.
sentences.cn_source: 我总有一天会接管这家公司。

sentences.c: She decided that I was the ideal person to take over the job.
sentences.cn_source: 她认定我是接管这项工作的最佳人选。

sentences.c: The army is threatening to take over if civil unrest continues.
sentences.cn_source: 军方扬言如果内乱继续就实行军管。

trans.cn: xảy ra
trans.cn_source: 发生

trans.cn: Xảy ra hoặc xảy ra, đặc biệt là điều gì đó đã được lên kế hoạch hoặc mong đợi: Đề cập đến điều gì đó đang xảy ra hoặc xảy ra tại một thời điểm hoặc địa điểm nhất định, đặc biệt là một sự kiện đã được lên kế hoạch hoặc dự kiến.
trans.cn_source: 发生或出现，尤指计划或预期的事情：指某件事情在某个时间或地点发生或进行，特别是指计划或预期的事件。

sentences.c: She wanted Randy's wedding to take place quickly.
sentences.cn_source: 她想让兰迪的婚礼马上举行。

sentences.c: My father gave me a lift to the sports ground, for the marathon race was going to take place there in an hour.
sentences.cn_source: 父亲开车送我到运动场，因为一小时后马拉松比赛将在那里举行。

sentences.c: The College Entrance Examination is scheduled to take place in June all over the country.
sentences.cn_source: 高考被安排在6月份于全国举行。

trans.cn: Làm việc không mệt mỏi và chăm chỉ

sentences.c: Youre very kind to take the trouble to help me.
sentences.cn_source: 你真热心，不闲麻烦的来帮助我。

sentences.c: You're very kind to take the trouble to help me.
sentences.cn_source: 帮助我为你添麻烦了，你的心真好。

sentences.c: You're very kind to take the trouble to help me.
sentences.cn_source: 你真好，不嫌麻烦地来帮助我。

trans.cn: bắt đầu làm; phát triển thói quen; phát triển sở thích

trans.cn: Thích, đến gần (người)

sentences.cn_source: 我喜欢它们散落在湖边长草中的样子，看起来就像要展翅飞翔一样。

sentences.cn_source: 他们准备了一个漂亮的篮子让小红帽带给外婆。

sentences.cn_source: 一个更便宜的选择是到海边。

sentences.cn_source: 我想继续谈一谈你早些时候提出的问题。

trans.cn: Do your best: Đề cập đến việc cố gắng hết sức để làm điều gì đó và sử dụng khả năng của bạn một cách tốt nhất.
trans.cn_source: 尽力而为：指尽力去做某事，尽力发挥自己的能力。

sentences.c: I take care of them to the best of my abilities.
sentences.cn_source: 我尽全力照顾他们。

sentences.cn_source: 据我所知，他从未立过遗嘱。

sentences.cn_source: 在危急时刻她总是挺身而出。

sentences.cn_source: 当你遇到困难不知选什么行动方案最好的时候，一个办法就是扔硬币来决定干什么好。

trans.cn_source: 放开，释放；听凭，放纵

sentences.cn_source: 这位信徒对我说：那晚，我既须坚持，又须放松，同时等待大光出现。

trans.cn: Tắt, tắt (nguồn nước, nguồn điện, gas, v.v.)
trans.cn_source: 关，关断（水源，电源，煤气等）

sentences.cn_source: 那架喷气式飞机开始拐出主跑道。

sentences.c: I want to turn on the television.
sentences.cn_source: 我想打开电视机。

sentences.cn_source: 要是我知道如何打开暖气装置就好了。

sentences.cn_source: 驾车者被强制要求在正午打开前灯。

sentences.c: One ought never to turn one's back on a threatened danger and try to run away from it.

trans.cn: Hóa ra là, (cuối cùng) đã được chứng minh là
trans.cn_source: 原来是，（最后）证明是

sentences.c: Their story, though not as spectacular to the eye, will surely turn out to be as subtle and as complex.
sentences.cn_source: 他们的故事虽然看起来不那么壮观，但肯定会变得同样微妙和复杂。

sentences.c: It may not turn out to be the best thing to do.
sentences.cn_source: 这可能不是最好的做法。
